utility.notes: Burbank Water and Power is the City of Burbank's own municipal electric utility. Burbank is notably absent from SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (which lists many neighboring LA County cities but not Burbank), consistent with Burbank having its own municipal utility rather than SCE service.

value.name: Burbank Water and Power (BWP)
value.notes: BWP is a vertically-integrated municipal utility (like LADWP, Pasadena Water and Power, and Glendale Water and Power) — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA. No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Burbank in the sources reviewed this session.

permit_authority.value: City of Burbank Building & Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: Burbank's own Solar Net Billing program, which replaced its prior Net Energy Metering program for all new permit applications starting January 1, 2026 — a genuinely distinctive municipal-utility policy shift (removed annual usage-based size caps, raised the maximum system size to 5 MW, and compensates excess generation at BWP's avoided cost of energy). Systems permitted before January 1, 2026 remain grandfathered under the prior NEM rate structure.

battery_programs.notes: The statewide SGIP program (administered by the CPUC-regulated IOUs) is not applicable to Burbank, since BWP is a municipal utility outside SGIP's administering IOUs' territories. No BWP-specific battery incentive program was confirmed this session.
